name: Special Meeting of the Parks and Recreation Commission
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  Albert O. Little Community Center
  18750 Clarkdale Avenue, Artesia CA 90701

  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 3, 2019

  CHAIRPERSON BOBBY MEDINA
  VICE CHAIRPERSON MANU PATEL
  COMMISSIONER SIVA SUBRAMANIAM
  COMMISSIONER BHAKTA THAPA
  COMMISSIONER LISA FALCAO

  5:00 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

APPROVAL OF THE AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS:
  Anyone wishing to speak to the Commission should fill out a speaker card and give that
  card to the recording staff person at the table prior to the commencement of the meeting.
  Please observe a limit of three (3) minutes allotted for each speaker.

CITIZEN COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA
  This time is for members of the public to address the Commission on items that are not
  listed on the agenda, but are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission.
  Comments on the listed agenda items will only be taken when the Commission reaches
  that item on the agenda.

BUSINESS ITEMS

  1. Discussion regarding policies, procedures, and practices related to closing the athletic
  fields at City parks.

  2. Discussion regarding policies, procedures, and practices for pricing and fees related to
  using the athletic fields at City parks.

  3. Commissioners’ Comments

ADJOURNMENT TO THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF THE PARKS AND RECREATION
COMMISSION TO BE HELD ON WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 23, 2019, AT 6:00 P.M. IN THE
ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER AT 18750 CLARKDALE AVE., ARTESIA.

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related modification or
accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please contact City Hall at (562) 865-
6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
